reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month to over 1200/month starting August 2026 (E-03), and among disputed bills more carry ACTUAL meter reads (1785) than ESTIMATED reads (1240, E-01), which weighs against estimate-substitution/read-delivery failure as the dominant cause and against a tariff change (ruled out, E-04). The evidence best supports a billing import validation rule change around August mis-processing/mis-validating normally-read bills during billing import, producing the incorrect charges driving the surge, with the field route-completion shortfall (88% vs 95% target, E-02) contributing a secondary minority of disputes via estimate substitution.
